purpose: Prevent silent semantic remapping in CAS Harness probes, fixtures, compilers, synthetic data, evidence packets, and external claims.
controlling_principles: TKS is the foundational semantic lineage for claim-bearing CAS Harness probes.
CAS operational extensions may implement, refine, or test TKS semantics but may not silently replace canonical meanings.
A source hash is part of the experimental subject. Byte-different definition payloads are different semantic versions until an explicit transformation manifest proves otherwise.
Universality is the project objective. Current evidence labels govern claim timing, not what the project is allowed to build or test.
Unknown models enter discovery and calibration; only unsupported customer verdicts fail closed.

known_conflicts.finding: TKS v7.4 and owner-locked original fixtures use A1-D10, while normalized canon_elements_40.json uses A0-D9. This is a cyclic index remapping, not a harmless display change.
known_conflicts.required_resolution: Publish and test a bijective code-and-meaning crosswalk; store both source_symbol and normalized_index in every artifact.

known_conflicts.finding: The payloads share the same 40 and 28 codes, but 20 of 40 Element definition strings and 8 of 28 Foundation strings differ. Some differences are substantive.
known_conflicts.required_resolution: Treat them as separate semantic versions; produce an owner-adjudicated transformation diff; retrain and evaluate against the selected claim-bearing hash.

known_conflicts.finding: canon_subfoundations_28_defs.json was used by original-TKS fixture work but is not listed or hashed by canon_index.json.
known_conflicts.required_resolution: Add it to the approved authority manifest or replace it with a locked owner payload.

known_conflicts.finding: TKS v7.4 presents A0 plus seven Desire, seven Wisdom, and seven Power acquisitions; normalized canon_acquisitions_22.json presents a different named 22-item vocabulary.
known_conflicts.required_resolution: Define whether these are two layers, aliases, or incompatible versions and publish an exact crosswalk before acquisition probes.

known_conflicts.finding: Programming in CAS chapter sources use Identity, Differentiation, Abstractification, Concretization, Integration, Empathetic Alignment, Critical Evaluation, Directed Focus, Expansion, and Contraction for indices 0-9, while normative CAS/TKS uses Idea, Mind, Positive, Negative, Vibration, Female, Male, Rhythm, Above/Cause, and Below/Effect.
known_conflicts.required_resolution: Mark the former vocabulary superseded/comparator-only and reconcile claim-bearing book, SDG, prompt, and training artifacts.

known_conflicts.finding: Existing artifacts map the four native TKS Worlds both to CAS Domains P/C/E/O and to CAS Registers T/A/f/E, although Domain and Register are separate CAS axes. A single World label therefore cannot be silently treated as both.
known_conflicts.required_resolution: Preserve native TKS World as its own field, define separate versioned World-to-Domain and World-to-Register hypotheses, and test each crosswalk as a distinct multi-head probe rather than declaring an identity.

known_conflicts.finding: The seven TKS Foundations and seven CAS Drives occupy parallel index positions in some operational artifacts but do not have definition-identical meanings.
known_conflicts.required_resolution: Name the native TKS-F28 and CAS Drive-by-Register systems separately; any mapping between them must carry a version, source hashes, and empirical consistency results.

known_conflicts.finding: The executable Rust CAS core uses a mod-10 Noetic algebra profile, while the broader TKS corpus includes richer or differently presented composition structures. Passing Rust algebra tests does not prove equivalence to every TKS composition table.
known_conflicts.required_resolution: Assign explicit algebra_profile identifiers, test any claimed translation, and bind the selected profile to compiler output, generated fixtures, probes, and Evidence Packets.

known_conflicts.finding: The SDG, generated fixtures, activation captures, and evaluation reports are not yet uniformly bound to the exact semantic source hash and crosswalk hash that produced their labels.
known_conflicts.required_resolution: Make semantic source, definition variant, symbol scheme, crosswalk, fixture, and generator hashes mandatory fields from generation through capture, evaluation, and packet verification.

known_conflicts.finding: The product-facing Noetic Topos chapter uses detection-oriented framing, while the conservative journal source explicitly defers empirical cognitive and safety measurement until operationalization, calibration, reliability, validation, and adversarial testing are completed.
known_conflicts.required_resolution: Use the Topos construction to preregister compatibility and gluing-residual hypotheses; require held-out model evidence and strong controls before any prompt-injection, hallucination, or safety-detection claim.

known_conflicts.finding: TKS supplies formal definitions, axioms, theorem statements, and proof sketches, but no Lean, Coq, Agda, Isabelle, TLA+, or Alloy proof artifact was located; formal target-space existence is not empirical LLM readability.
known_conflicts.required_resolution: Tag every cited item as definition, axiom, proved-on-paper theorem, proof sketch, mechanically verified result, implementation test, or empirical model result.

known_conflicts.finding: No exact file named main.md was located in the TKS corpus or workspace. The relevant local Noetic Topos sources located are peer_review/journal_submission/main.tex and dashboard/public/noetic-topos.md.
known_conflicts.required_resolution: Add the exact main.md path if a separate source exists; do not pretend it was reviewed.

claim_bearing_precedence: Exact field authority for the definition being probed
future_agent_rules: Do not use compact CAS summaries as substitutes for original TKS definitions in a claim-bearing probe unless the compact form is an explicitly named comparator arm.
Do not remap A1-D10 to A0-D9 by position without a tested crosswalk.
Do not call D3DAC0EF and A124302E the same definition version.
Do not use formal universality of the TKS codomain as proof of empirical hidden-state readability.
Do use TKS as the invariant semantic output space and learn model-specific maps into it.
Do attempt automatic discovery and canary capture on unknown open-weight models; fail closed only on customer verdict or unsafe execution.
Do pair every OPEN or NOT LICENSED capability with a closure experiment, required evidence, compute tier, and next action.
